Microsoft Ignite · San Francisco

Book meetings at Microsoft Ignite with the IT, cloud and security leaders you sell to.

Ignite brings Microsoft's enterprise customers and partner ecosystem to one place. If you sell into Azure, Microsoft 365 or Microsoft security environments, these are your buyers. We get you on their calendars before the show.

Book Ignite meetings with A8Z

How do you book meetings at Microsoft Ignite? Start 6-8 weeks before the event. Identify Ignite attendees and target accounts that match your ICP, such as CIOs, IT directors, cloud architects and security leaders in Microsoft environments, plus Microsoft partners. Reach them by email, LinkedIn and phone with a specific reason to meet, and offer short meetings at your booth or near Moscone Center. A8Z runs this end to end for B2B software vendors.

Who we reach for you at Ignite

Enterprise IT and cloud buyers

CIOs, IT directors, Azure architects and infrastructure leaders at your target accounts.

Security leaders

CISOs and security teams running Microsoft security and identity stacks who need what you add on top.

Microsoft partners

Solution partners, resellers and ISVs who can bring your product into their deals, and vendors you integrate with.

Ignite 2026 is close. What's still possible?

With Ignite on November 17, there's about two weeks for outreach. That's enough for a short, focused list of your highest-priority accounts, plus post-event follow-up with everyone who attended. For the best results, plan Ignite 2027 with us 8 weeks out.

Microsoft Ignite meeting booking questions

When and where is Microsoft Ignite 2026?

Microsoft Ignite 2026 runs November 17-20, 2026 at the Moscone Center in San Francisco, with a digital option. Check Microsoft's official Ignite site for the latest details.

When should we start booking meetings for Ignite?

6-8 weeks before the event, so in late September or early October for a mid-November Ignite.

Can you book meetings with Microsoft partners as well as customers?

Yes. We can run a separate outreach track for Microsoft solution partners, resellers and ISVs alongside customer meetings.

Who is a good fit for Ignite meeting booking?

B2B software vendors with fewer than 1,000 employees selling into Microsoft environments (Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft security), sending a small team to Ignite without a dedicated SDR team.

Going to Microsoft Ignite?

Tell us your ICP. We'll show you how many relevant Ignite attendees we can reach for you.
